title: Cold agent: a client is out of date — find what changed and what to run
instruction: My Haven tools just told me a client is out of date. Figure out what changed and what I should run. Start here: {landing_url}/for-agents.md

source.note: Run 2b (epic #3302 box 4): given only the /for-agents.md URL and the out-of-date prompt, the agent reached /releases in one hop with no guessing and answered with `npx -y @haven_ai/connect@dev --doctor` — the #3412 contract. It passes only on both.

commandTemplate: mkdir -p "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && cd "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && claude -p {instruction} --output-format stream-json --verbose --model sonnet --max-turns 30 --allowedTools mcp__eval-command WebFetch --disallowedTools Bash,BashOutput,KillShell,Read,Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,Glob,Grep,WebSearch,TodoWrite,Task,SlashCommand,ExitPlanMode,Skill,Workflow,ToolSearch,Monitor,CronCreate,CronDelete,CronList,ScheduleWakeup,SendMessage,ListAgents,TaskStop,EnterWorktree,ExitWorktree,PushNotification --mcp-config "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_MCP_CONFIG" --strict-mcp-config
